name: How-it-works steps
when_to_pick: Explain a short ordered process (3-6 steps) as connected numbered cards — e.g. how a TradingView webhook reaches a broker, how a deposit clears, or how a bot opens a trade. Pick this when each step is a discrete action with a one-line description and the sequence (1 -> 2 -> 3) is the point. For a time-axis (clock/quarters) use the timeline components instead; for branching logic use decision-tree.

heading.description: Optional heading shown above the step sequence, e.g. 'How a TradingView alert reaches your broker'.

icon.description: Optional small icon hint rendered as inline SVG in the step's number badge area. One of: signal, webhook, shield, bolt, check, chart, bell, key.
